recognize_zh: CD3 圈選的 T 細胞中，CD4+（綠）主族群幾乎都 CD26 陰性，只有少數 CD4+CD26+ 正常細胞向上延伸；CD26 流失是 Sézary 細胞較敏感的流式標記。
features: Dot plot gated on CD3+ T cells: CD4-FITC (x) versus CD26-PE (y)
Dominant CD4+ population (green) with absent CD26 expression
Minor tail of CD4+CD26+ normal helper T cells extending upward
CD4-negative T cells (red) are small in number
Pattern indicates an expanded CD4+CD26− T-cell population
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on CD3-positive T cells demonstrates a large CD4-positive population that is predominantly CD26-negative, with only a small residual CD4+CD26+ subset. The CD4-negative T-cell population is proportionally small. An expanded CD4+CD26− population (≥30% of lymphocytes) is a sensitive marker of Sézary cells and, with clonality and clinical erythroderma, supports Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Benign erythroderma may show modest CD26 loss but not a dominant clonal CD4+CD26− population with a very high CD4:CD8 ratio.
ATLL can also be CD26-negative but is CD25 bright and HTLV-1 positive.
T-PLL typically expresses CD26 and CD7 and carries TCL1 rearrangement.
